description: Lazy 可以表示閒散不活動、不願付出努力、長期懶惰、怠惰、無精打采、做事漫不經心，或只是節奏放鬆。 因此要分清 effort, inactivity, energy level, carelessness, temporary motivation, and relaxed personality。

words.example: He spent most of the afternoon idle instead of finishing the report.
words.exampleZh: 他下午大部分時間都閒着，沒有完成報告。

exercises.original: He spent a lazy afternoon doing almost nothing.
exercises.zh: 他度過了一個幾乎甚麼都沒做的懶散下午。

options.explanation: Idle ✓ — not working or active when activity or effort would normally be expected。關鍵線索是 an inactive period is being described；因此這是最精準的替換。
Lethargic — lacking energy or enthusiasm, often appearing slow, tired, or inactive。強調低能量／無精打采；若句子是在批評不願努力或漫不經心，不能等同 lazy。
Laid-back — relaxed, easy-going, and not easily stressed or hurried。通常是正面／中性，表示放鬆隨和；真正逃避責任的 lazy 不適合。
Relaxed — free from tension or anxiety。只表示沒有壓力或緊張，不表示不願工作。
Tired — in need of rest。只是疲倦；人可以很累但仍很勤力。
Slow — not fast。只描述速度，不描述努力意願。

Idle — not working or active when activity or effort would normally be expected。強調沒有活動；可能只是沒有工作可做，不一定是懶。
Tired — in need of rest。只是疲倦；人可以很累但仍很勤力。
Laid-back ✓ — relaxed, easy-going, and not easily stressed or hurried。關鍵線索是 relaxed style without irresponsibility is central；因此這是最精準的替換。
Slow — not fast。只描述速度，不描述努力意願。
Unmotivated — lacking motivation。是缺乏動機；原因可能很多，不能自動判定為懶惰。

exercises.original: The café has a lazy atmosphere where nobody seems in a hurry.
exercises.zh: 這間咖啡店氣氛悠閒，沒有人看起來很趕。

falseSynonyms.zh: 放鬆 ≠ lazy relaxed 表示不緊張，不等於不願努力。
疲倦 ≠ lazy 累可能令行動變慢，但不是懶惰。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Tiredness is not unwillingness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 悠閒 ≠ lazy laid-back 常是正面，表示隨和放鬆。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Laid-back is not inherently negative.

falseSynonyms.zh: 慢 ≠ lazy 做事慢不一定是不願努力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Speed and effort differ.

falseSynonyms.zh: 缺乏動機 ≠ all lazy unmotivated 可能有其他原因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Motivation and laziness are not identical.

falseSynonyms.zh: 閒着 ≠ always lazy idle 可只是沒有工作可做。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Inactivity may be circumstantial.

falseSynonyms.zh: 無精打采 ≠ lazy lethargic 主要是能量低。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Low energy differs from unwillingness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 lazy 是形容詞；laziness 是名詞。
